[PREFERENCE] User is interested in marinades or seasonings that would pair well with a sweet and smoky flavor profile.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested marinades include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Sweet & Smoky BBQ Marinade: 1/2 cup ketchup, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Honey Mustard BBQ Marinade: 1/2 cup honey, 1/4 cup Dijon mustard, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Molasses & Bourbon Marinade: 1/2 cup molasses, 1/4 cup bourbon whiskey, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested seasonings include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Smoky Sweet Rub: 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 2 tablespoons smoked paprika, 1 tablespoon chili powder, 1 tablespoon garlic powder, 1 tablespoon onion powder, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sweet Heat Rub: 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 tablespoon smoked paprika, 1 tablespoon chili powder, 1 tablespoon ground cumin, 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Grill Master's Magic Dust: 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 tablespoon smoked paprika, 1 tablespoon garlic powder, 1 tablespoon onion powder, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for grilling chicken breasts include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Marinate chicken breasts for at least 2 hours or overnight for maximum flavor penetration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Preheat grill to medium-high heat (around 375°F) for a nice sear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Don't press down on chicken while grilling to retain juices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Let chicken rest for 5-10
